SSS41.name: 逆流龙鱼
SSS41.form: a flattened wedge-shaped head, a prismatic horn crest, ringed segmented plates along the flank, a pair of long jointed barbels curving back, evenly spaced dorsal spines shrinking toward the tail
SSS41.fins: long trailing pectoral fins, a thin ribbon-like tail fin
SSS41.markings: concentric ring bands along the flanks, a single luminous arc at the base of the tail

SSS42.name: 残时皇带
SSS42.form: a narrow ribbon-like head with a small upturned snout, a translucent domed cranium, a fan-shaped crest of soft rays rising from the nape, a chain of eroded ring segments along the flank
SSS42.fins: a continuous dorsal crest running the full length of the back, a pair of long oar-like pelvic fins, a tiny rounded tail fin
SSS42.markings: a series of broken ring segments along the flank, a single stilled ripple line near the gill cover

SSS43.name: 虚时鮟鱇
SSS43.form: a bulky rounded body with a smooth matte surface, a broad flattened head, an upturned wide mouth, small eyes set high, a slender rod-like lure rising from the snout
SSS43.fins: a small rounded dorsal fin, short rounded pectoral fins, a rounded tail fin
SSS43.markings: a faint grid of fine lines across the back, a single ring around the eye

SSS44.name: 千面章鱼
SSS44.form: a spindle-shaped mantle with overlapping layered rings, a smooth matte surface, eight arms of graded length fanned at even intervals, a single long filamentous tentacle
SSS44.fins: a pair of small triangular fins set midway along the mantle
SSS44.markings: stacked layer lines across the mantle, a ring of faint pits at the arm bases

SSS45.name: 逆空鲛
SSS45.form: a slender elongated build with a strongly tapered rear, a row of broad saw-toothed teeth, five long gill slits, fused ring plates along the flank
SSS45.fins: a crescent-shaped tail fin with a long upper lobe, long narrow pectoral fins
SSS45.markings: faint concentric growth rings along the flank, a single line of dots below the gill slits

SSS46.name: 溯光鲹
SSS46.form: a streamlined spindle-shaped body with a keeled belly, a small pointed head, a terminal mouth, a gently curved lateral line, small cycloid scales
SSS46.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, a row of small finlets behind the dorsal and anal fins
SSS46.markings: a row of evenly spaced luminous pores along the flank, faint vertical hairlines near the head

SSS47.name: 旧日水母
SSS47.form: a flattened bell with a scalloped rim, a ring of evenly spaced luminous nodes at the bell margin, four short oral arms, thin tentacles gathered into bundles
SSS47.markings: concentric rings across the bell, faint radial spokes from the center

SSS48.name: 影时鲽
SSS48.form: a strongly flattened oval body, both eyes on one side, a small twisted mouth, a thin wavy margin along the fin edge
SSS48.fins: a long dorsal fin fringing the upper margin, a matching anal fin along the lower margin, a rounded tail fin
SSS48.markings: an irregular mosaic of patches over the eyed side, a faint ring near the tail base

SSS49.name: 回环鳕
SSS49.form: an elongated body that curls into a gentle spiral, a rounded head, a small barbel at the chin, fine cycloid scales
SSS49.fins: three separate dorsal fins, two anal fins, a rounded tail fin
SSS49.markings: a loop of concentric arcs along the flank, a single dot near the gill cover

SSS50.name: 沉默巨口鳗
SSS50.form: a compressed band-like body, a gaping oversized mouth reaching far behind the eye, a blunt rounded snout, no pectoral fins
SSS50.fins: a continuous dorsal fin joined to the anal and tail fin
SSS50.markings: a single stilled wave line running the length of the flank
